purpose: A transition whose target a cross event steps keeps its history through rejected steps: stateCtl(.revert) takes back what a rejected attempt advanced.

oracle.derivation: VAMS-2023 4.5.8 and 5.10.3: V(in) = t/10u crosses 0.5 V upward at t = 5 us, where lvl steps 0 -> 1, and transition(lvl, 0, 1u) slews V(out) linearly from 0 to 1 over [5 us, 6 us]. V(out) is driven, so the R-L-C tank only shapes the timestep (252 LTE and 12 state rejections). Without the revert the output steps at the first rejected attempt past 5 us (|error| ~ 1 V).
